items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' and the boilerplate identifies the interviewer as Monk Rowe. There is no evidence of a prior personal or professional relationship beyond the current interview context.

ctx.x: Cool. Well that’s a great way to wrap up our conversation. I realy enjoyed chatting with you, Tony.
Oh Monk, it was a pleasure. The same. And I hope you could see more than just my bouncing ball here. I wasn’t sure of the video.
All right. I’ll just pause here and we’ll say our good-byes.
